lessons.key: ac_gap::for a service that writes to an external store before a db transaction add a test that injects a failing store double and asserts zero rows were written at the service level not just that the adapter itself returns an error
lessons.text: For a service that writes to an external store before a DB transaction, add a test that injects a failing store double and asserts zero rows were written at the service level, not just that the adapter itself returns an error.
